macros.name: ActiveBarPrimitive
macros.doc: \ActiveBarPrimitive is used by all “baritem” commands to draw something that represents a bar.

macros.name: bardiagrambegin
macros.doc: The \bardiagrambegin begins a bar diagram and \bardigramend ends it.

macros.name: bardiagramend
macros.doc: Any diagram begins with \bardiagrambegin and ends with \bardiagramend commands.

macros.name: baritem
macros.doc: Command \baritem{caption}{value}{color} Draws a bar of height value using color color and prints caption below it.

macros.name: baritem
macros.doc: Command \baritem{caption}{value}{color} Draws a bar of height value using color color and prints caption below it.

macros.name: barRect
macros.doc: The default value , \barRect, produces a flat rectangle and \barCylinder a cylinder.

macros.name: barRect
macros.doc: The default value , \barRect, produces a flat rectangle and \barCylinder a cylinder.

macros.name: diagLegendbegin
macros.doc: Any legend begins with \diagLegendbegin{Xupleft}{Yupleft}{width}, where the first two arguments represent the upper left point of the legend’s bounding box (see Fig.2.5) and the last one its width.

macros.name: diagLegendend
macros.doc: To finish the legend the \diagLegendend is used.

macros.name: diagLegenditem
macros.doc: \diagLegenditem{caption}{icolor} produces a rectangle of the color icolor and prints caption next to it.

macros.name: diagLegenditem
macros.doc: \diagLegenditem{caption}{icolor} produces a rectangle of the color icolor and prints caption next to it.

macros.name: diagLegendoptions

arg.snippet: diagLegendoptions{${1:frame fill color}}{${2:frame line color}}{${3:frame line width}}

macros.doc: \diagLegendoptions{}{}{} is used to change the legend background color (#1), frame line color (#2), and frame line width (#3).

macros.name: drawlevellines
macros.doc: Command \drawlevellines draws horizontal lines and put ticks with numbers along the y-axis.

macros.name: frameTD
macros.doc: Frame can be done 3-dimensional by using the switch \frameTD.

macros.name: subbaritem
macros.doc: \subbaritem{}{}{} is used to produce a bar next to the previous bar (on the right hand side) without any space in between.

macros.name: subbaritem
macros.doc: \subbaritem{}{}{} is used to produce a bar next to the previous bar (on the right hand side) without any space in between.

macros.name: subtopbaritem
macros.doc: \subtopbaritem{}{}{} is used to produce a bar on top of the previous bar.

macros.name: subtopbaritem
macros.doc: \subtopbaritem{}{}{} is used to produce a bar on top of the previous bar.
